system.description: Your Web Anchors lets you know when danger is coming for your allies, before they are even aware. When a willing allied creature that you can see, who is within 30 feet of a Web Anchor takes damage, you can spend your reaction to launch a silk line to them, and pull them 30 feet, ending this movement on the Web Anchor. If the triggering attack was from a melee attack, this reaction occurs before the attack is made, potentially causing the triggering attack to miss, if the ally leaves the attackers reach.
